title: Vazhinji Vakaparara
intro: Unomira pamberi pemanzwi enharaunda ine nyaya yakanyorwa mumafungu. Mweya iyi yakanzwa kudanwa, yakasarudza kusateerera, uye yakatarisana nemugumisiro wakachinja nyika. Ndivanaani, uye chii chakazoitika kunyika yavo?
clues: Takararama kare kare, uye mutumwa akauya kwatiri achibva pakati pedu.
Takanamata zvidhori zvishanu uye takaramba kuzvisiya.
Takaseka mutumwa uye takamupomera kuti akarasika.
Takamukumbira kuti ape chirango kana akataura chokwadi.
Takaona denga richidurura mvura uye nyika ichitumbuka zvitubu.
Takakwira kunzvimbo dzakakwirira kuti titize, asi mafungu akatibata.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Tose takaparara kunze kwevatendi pamwe naNuh
outcome.answer: Tose takaparara kunze kwevatendi pamwe naNuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
